Barn 1.4.0 adds `barn image update` and refreshes the Debian 13 image to
Debian 13.8 on amd64 and arm64.

## Upgrade from 1.3.0

Upgrade the Barn executable before refreshing the official image catalog.
The global and China repositories will switch to a new Minisign key with
catalog revision `2026112601`. Barn 1.3.0 rejects that signature. A failed
refresh leaves the previously active catalog available.

## Update Linux images

```bash
barn image update --dry-run
barn image update
barn image update d13i d13a
```

The first command previews updates to cached images. The second downloads
them and verifies their digests. The last command selects the amd64 and arm64
builds of Debian 13 explicitly. Use `--mirror` for the China repository or
`--repo` for a custom repository. To refresh only catalog metadata, use
`barn update`.

By default Barn keeps older image files. Add `--prune` to remove files the
active catalog, applied VMs and local image aliases no longer use. To try the
new base, create a new VM with `vm_image: d13`. Existing VMs continue to use
their original base.

The embedded catalog selects `d13@20261123.2671.1` on both architectures.
Both builds passed native boot, cloud-init, SSH through both interfaces,
root disk growth and XFS persistence checks across a restart.
